periods.time: vol-16 ch-004, after Alice lets Or-Gaule flee

name.zh: 一辉承认艾莉丝的骑士道并向她挑战
name.en: Ikki acknowledges Alice's chivalry and challenges her

periods.summary: After Alice protects Or-Gaule, Stella prepares to cut her down, but Ikki arrives and tells Stella to pursue Or-Gaule because only her flight can catch him. Ikki stays behind to face Alice, fulfilling his promise to take responsibility for rejecting Yui Tatara's warning. Instead of condemning Alice with easy moral slogans, Ikki says that if she knowingly betrays duty, morality, trust and even her own self-forgiveness to protect Or-Gaule, then that choice is her own chivalry. He declares that his weakest blade will block her path. Alice is moved because he treats her not as a monster to be lectured but as an equal enemy. She suppresses the urge to thank him, accepts her unforgivable path with pride, and releases a sword aura approaching the pressure Ikki once felt from Edelweiss. They introduce themselves and begin a formal duel.
periods.cause: Ikki's prior decision to trust Alice makes him responsible for stopping her once her true wish conflicts with Vermillion's mission.
periods.outcome: Stella leaves to chase Or-Gaule; Ikki and Alice begin a one-on-one battle between incompatible chivalries.
periods.significance: Transforms Alice's betrayal from a simple moral failure into a clash of chosen knightly paths and marks Ikki's growth in composure before a world-class opponent.
